draft.emotion: matter-of-fact and neutral, describing someone who has not lived many years
notes: Literally 'little age'. Unlike เด็ก (child, or young and immature), อายุน้อย is a polite, neutral way to say someone is young in years, including young adults.

senses.definition: Of a person: having lived for relatively few years; young in age.

examples.emotion: admiring and respectful, acknowledging someone's talent despite their youth
